name: Stow in Darkness
body:
School illusion (shadow) [darkness]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object weighing no more than 5lbs per caster level
Duration instantaneous

With a whisper and flick of the rist you open a small portal to the plane of shadow.

You can store an item inside this pocket of shadow for an indefinite period of time.

For the next 24 hours after casting this spell you can retrieve the item as a swift action. Otherwise the next time you cast this spell you cause the stored item to appear in an unoccupied square adjacent to you.
